title: Show HN: Teach your kids perfect pitch
summary: B# is a web-based application designed to help children develop perfect pitch through interactive audio training exercises, gamifying the learning process for young musicians during their critical learning years.
problem_solved: Addresses the difficulty of training perfect pitch in children, which traditionally requires expensive private lessons or specialized training programs.
why_valuable: Perfect pitch is a rare and highly valuable skill for musicians that must be developed early in life, and this open-source tool makes structured ear training accessible to any parent or educator.
